# smartcube-web-bluetooth (vendored)

The smart-cube protocols (GAN, MoYu, QiYi, GoCube, Giiker) from
[poliva/smartcube-web-bluetooth](https://github.com/poliva/smartcube-web-bluetooth)
by Pau Oliva and Andy Fedotov, MIT licence ([LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)).

Copied unchanged from commit `44f1f09` (version 4.0.0), without its tests: it is
not published on npm, so an npm package can't depend on it.

To update: copy `src/` (without `*.test.ts` and `test/`) from a newer commit
over this folder and note the commit here.
